wrap_optimizer_hook: wrap an OptimizerHook class to raise NotImplementedError when gradient clipping is used on IPU

review_IPUFp16OptimizerHook_init: review the IPUFp16OptimizerHook __init__ to verify grad_clip is None and loss_scale is a float
